extracted.intended_audience: USPTO patent examiners / Patent Office Professionals
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for examiners on using and composing MPEP form paragraph 7.39.01 to notify pro se applicants of options after a final rejection, and on related procedural statements that must appear in final rejections. Covers when to use the paragraph, required content, links, and preceding form-paragraph requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of form paragraph 7.39.01 for pro se last-response
rubrics_metrics.description: Form paragraph 7.39.01 must be used when the last response was signed only by the applicant (pro se) who is not a patent practitioner.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examiner Note 1: This form paragraph must be used when the last response was signed only by the applicant (pro se) who is not a patent practitioner.

rubrics_metrics.name: Placement requirement: preceding form paragraphs
rubrics_metrics.description: The form paragraph must be preceded by any one of form paragraphs 7.39, 7.40, 7.40.01, 7.40.02.aia, 7.40.02.fti, 7.41, 7.42.03.fti, or 7.42.09.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examiner Note 2: Ensure that ¶7.39.01 follows one of the listed form paragraphs in the final rejection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement that action is a final rejection and closes prosecution
rubrics_metrics.description: The paragraph must state: 'This action is a final rejection and closes the prosecution of this application.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This opening sentence informs the applicant that the prosecution is closed unless timely action is taken under the limited options described.

rubrics_metrics.name: List of limited options under 37 CFR 1.113 after final rejection
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant’s reply under 37 CFR 1.113 to this action is limited to an appeal to the PTAB, an amendment complying with the specified requirements, or a request for continued examination (RCE) to reopen prosecution where permitted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must explicitly inform applicant of the three limited procedural avenues available after a final rejection (appeal, proper after-final amendment, or RCE) and that these are subject to the statutory/regulatory requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice of USPTO initiatives and link to initiatives timeline
rubrics_metrics.description: Advise that the Office offers initiatives available to applicants after close of prosecution and provide the initiatives timeline link: https://www.uspto.gov/patents/initiatives/uspto-patent-applications-initiatives-timeline.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourage applicants to review available initiatives promptly after receiving a final rejection; include the provided link for more information.

rubrics_metrics.name: PTAB general information and pro bono program referral with urgency note
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide general PTAB information and a link to the PTAB Pro Bono Program (https://www.uspto.gov/patents/patent-trial-and-appeal-board/patent-trial-and-appeal-board-pro-bono-program-independent) and note that some assistance is time-limited and should be requested within one month from the date of the latest rejection.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the PTAB about page link and emphasize prompt review because some assistance must be requested within one month; refer to MPEP §1204 for more information on filing a notice of appeal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice of appeal filing deadline and fee requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: If applicant desires to appeal, a Notice of Appeal must be filed within the period for reply and must be accompanied by the fee required by 37 CFR 41.20(b)(1). The current fee amount is available at: www.uspto.gov/Fees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inform the applicant of the timing and fee requirement for an appeal and provide the fees link so applicants can confirm current amounts.

rubrics_metrics.name: After-final amendment entry limitations
rubrics_metrics.description: Entry of a proposed after-final amendment cannot be made as a matter of right unless it merely cancels claims or complies with a formal requirement made in a previous Office action. Amendments touching the merits may be admitted only upon a showing of good and sufficient reasons why they are necessary and why they were not presented earlier.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain the narrow circumstances in which after-final amendments will be entered and the burden on the applicant to show good and sufficient reasons for merit-affecting amendments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirement for replies under 37 CFR 1.113 to address each rejected claim
rubrics_metrics.description: A reply under 37 CFR 1.113 to a final rejection must include cancellation of or appeal from the rejection of each rejected claim.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notify applicants that any reply must either cancel or appeal each rejected claim; partial silence on rejected claims is not sufficient.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effect of after-final amendment on statutory reply period
rubrics_metrics.description: The filing of an amendment after final rejection, whether or not it is entered, does not stop the running of the statutory period for reply to the final rejection unless the examiner holds all of the claims to be in condition for allowance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Warn applicants that submitting an after-final amendment will generally not extend the statutory deadline for reply unless examiner action places all claims in condition for allowance.

rubrics_metrics.name: RCE filing availability and reference to MPEP for requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: If applicant desires to continue prosecution in a utility or plant application filed on or after May 29, 2000 and have the finality of this Office action withdrawn, an RCE under 37 CFR 1.114 may be filed within the period for reply. See MPEP § 706.07(h) for more information on the requirements for filing an RCE.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inform applicants about RCE eligibility for certain applications, the timing (within the period for reply), and direct them to MPEP §706.07(h) for filing requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Abandonment warning and exceptions for preserving prosecution
rubrics_metrics.description: The application will become abandoned unless a Notice of Appeal, an after final reply that places the application in condition for allowance, or an RCE has been filed properly within the period for reply, or any extension of this period obtained under either 37 CFR 1.136(a) or (b).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clearly state the consequences of inaction and list the filings or extensions that prevent abandonment.
